data.title: 蕾塞 · 浴室镜前
data.description: 【蕾塞 · 浴室镜前】水汽弥漫的浴室里，沐浴完毕的蕾塞赤身站在起雾的镜子前，用纤细的指尖在水雾上画了一颗心。透过镜中模糊的倒影，她看向身后的你，眼眸水光潋滟——「镜子上的这颗心……是画给你的哦。不打算走过来把它擦干净，看清楚现在的我吗？」
data.action: 站在镜前，指尖划过雾面
data.camera: medium shot, rear three-quarter view toward the mirror
data.promptProse: Adult Reze draws a heart in the misted mirror with one hand, gathering her hair in the other. Her partial reflection looks toward the off-frame viewer behind her through steam-diffused light.
data.animaCaption: One hand draws the heart on the misted mirror while the other gathers her wet hair.
